source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    blocks = []
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if all(grid[i][j] == 2 for i, j in ((r,c),(r,c+1),(r+1,c),(r+1,c+1))):
                blocks.append((r, c))
    for r, c in blocks:
        positions = {
            "nw": (r-1, c-1), "ne": (r-1, c+2),
            "sw": (r+2, c-1), "se": (r+2, c+2),
        }
        if not all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w for rr, cc in positions.values()):
            continue
        values = {key: grid[rr][cc] for key, (rr, cc) in positions.items()}
        rays = (("nw", -1, -1, values["sw"]),
                ("ne", -1, 1, values["nw"]),
                ("sw", 1, -1, values["se"]),
                ("se", 1, 1, values["ne"]))
        for key, dr, dc, color in rays:
            rr, cc = positions[key]
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
                rr += dr
                cc += dc
    return out
'''
